summary_en: The caller began the call by expressing extreme frustration and anger, accusing the company of being useless, idiotic, and fraudulent. The agent responded by acknowledging the caller's time and politely saying goodbye. The caller did not engage further and did not request any assistance or provide any additional context. The call ended immediately after the agent's closing remark.
objections: Caller accused the company of being fraudulent and expressed severe frustration.
notes: The caller rejected the interaction entirely through hostile language, constituting a clear refusal of the offer and further contact.
